import java.util.Scanner;

public class GeneticEngineering {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        String str = sc.nextLine();
        sc.close();

        int res = 0;
        int n = str.length();
        
        int i = 0;
        while (i < n) {
            int j = i;
            while (j < n && str.charAt(j) == str.charAt(i)) {
                j++;
            }
            
            int len = j - i;
            // For even length sequences, we need to break them by inserting one character
            // to make them odd. The minimum insertions for a sequence of length len is len/2
            // because we can insert a different nucleotide every 2 positions to break even-length runs
            res += len / 2;
            
            i = j;
        }
        
        System.out.print(res);
    }
}
